_comment: The teams the concierge follows. These are the presenter's real follows as of August 11, 2026, the ones used in the September 16 session. Replace them with yours: this file is the only thing the agent knows about you.
_abbr_note: Abbreviations COLLIDE across sports: MIN is both the Lynx and the Vikings, POR is both the Fire and the Trail Blazers, SEA is both the Storm and the Seahawks, NY is both the Liberty and (as NYG/NYJ) New York's NFL teams. Every follow is therefore keyed by {sport, abbr}, never by abbr alone. The abbreviation must be the one the data uses (the Warriors are GS, not GSW); run the tool read and check your team appears under Following by full name.

followed.label: Minnesota Lynx
followed.why: Olivia Miles, and the offense generally — the most fun team in the league to actually sit and watch.

followed.label: New York Liberty
followed.why: JJ and Stewie. Two of the best players in the world on the same floor.

followed.why: The grit, and a coach with genuinely interesting ideas about how practice should work.
